description: This file defines a Swift class 'WatchConnectivityReceiver' that manages communication between an iOS app and a watchOS app using the WatchConnectivity framework. It handles activation, message sending, receiving, and parsing notification payloads, and interacts with a store 'WatchInboxStore' for message consumption.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: A class that manages WatchConnectivity session, sending, and receiving messages with a watchOS device.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the WCSession and sets its delegate.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the WCSession is activated, waiting with retries if necessary.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to the watch, using either sendMessage or transferUserInfo based on reachability.
